disclaimer: Prototype action mappings for synthetic administrative offices; not USDA, OPM, NOAA or AirNow closure policy.

rules.conditions: Actual Severe/Extreme Flood or Flash Flood Warning, point confirmed, unexpired, overlaps work period
rules.reference_claim: NWS supplies alert categories and instructions, not this prototype closure mapping.
rules.prototype_mapping_reason: Avoid routine onsite reporting in a warning area pending manager review.
rules.required_context: Before opening; during an ongoing shift require local emergency procedure review.
rules.limitations: Does not prove building inundation or mandate evacuation.

rules.conditions: Actual High Wind Warning, point confirmed, unexpired, overlaps work period, telework supported
rules.reference_claim: Warning category is NWS evidence; telework is a prototype mapping.
rules.prototype_mapping_reason: Reduce routine commute exposure subject to manager review.
rules.limitations: No invented wind speed exceedance; no route safety guarantee.

rules.conditions: Fresh modeled AQ valid for the selected window and US AQI >=151
rules.reference_claim: AQI 151–200 is the unhealthy category. This does not prescribe office closure.
rules.prototype_mapping_reason: Use telework candidate to reduce routine outdoor exposure; manager validates local context.
rules.limitations: Modeled grid estimate; not indoor or building sensor reading.
